title: Pressure regulators.
officialText:
A line pressure regulator shall be installed where the appliance is designed to operate at a lower pressure
than the supply pressure. Line gas pressure regulators shall be listed as complying with ANSI Z21.80. Access shall be provided to
pressure regulators. Pressure regulators shall be protected from physical damage. Regulators installed on the exterior of the building
shall be approved for outdoor installation.
